note: vespera-bridge audit fixes: a non-web Spring Boot app without spring-web starts again (the core autoconfiguration no longer loads PathPatternParser); on virtual threads SmartDispatchModeResolver streams the response of safe requests (like DIRECT's overflow stash on platform threads) instead of buffering it, so large downloads and Accept-less event streams work (opt back into parking SYNC with new SmartDispatchModeResolver(direct, sync, true)); 1xx / 204 / 304 responses no longer carry Content-Length: 0; unpaired UTF-16 surrogates in wire header strings are encoded as U+FFFD instead of a \uD800 escape the Rust parser rejects; a prefix-mapped DispatcherServlet path is stripped from the forwarded path by decoded segments (%61pi, //, dot segments, %2F); an ASYNC dispatch that hits Spring's async timeout answers the proxy's plain-text 503 with the request id instead of the /error page; the springdoc group-mode document endpoint is mapped from the normalized docs-path (trailing slash, blank) and a root or pattern docs-path fails the startup clearly; dispatchDirectPooled / BufferTooSmallException / DispatchMode / VesperaClient docs describe the overflow stash and poll-first parking.
